_about.purpose: Chooses which video model generates each section of a music video, based on the section's type and analysed energy. Keeps the 8GB VRAM budget (D7) by sending only the sections that need quality to an expensive model.

schema.rules: evaluated in order; the FIRST matching rule wins
schema.rules[].match.section_type: required - the analysed section label (intro, verse, chorus, bridge, drop, breakdown, outro, ...)
schema.rules[].match.energy_max: optional - upper bound on the section's 0..1 analysed energy; the rule does not apply above it
schema.rules[].model: model id to render with; must exist in app/core/model_tiers.py
schema.rules[].tier: draft | balanced | quality - controls VRAM budget and render time
schema.rules[].reason: human-readable justification, surfaced in the wizard so a choice is never opaque

_about.extending: Insert a new rule ABOVE any broader rule you want it to override, since first match wins. Keep energy_max consistent with the section type, or a quiet chorus will be caught by the verse rule.

rules.reason: Low-energy intro; fast draft model is sufficient
Fade-out outro; draft tier keeps VRAM headroom
Build section; balanced model preserves detail
Hero shot — highest quality local model
Drop/buildup — hero tier for peak moments
Quiet bridge; fastest iteration to preserve contrast

cloud_gateway.notes: Cloud-burst for hero shots when local VRAM is saturated
